## F4 Spray Paint — Changelog (18.06.2026)

### Improvements

Optimization Improvements
Improved overall performance and resource optimization across the spray system.

---

### Bug Fixes

Config.UseItem Check
Fixed an issue where item checks were still being performed even when `Config.UseItem` was set to `false`.

Live Preview Stability
Fixed an issue that could cause players to disconnect from the server while using the Live Preview feature.

---

### Internal Changes

- Improved performance in core spray painting systems
- Optimized validation and item checking logic
- Improved Live Preview synchronization and stability
